calendarOverlaps.title: Calendar overlap warnings
calendarOverlaps.help: Private warnings from saved imports in the next 366 days, including events already in progress. Only timed events with a valid end are compared; all-day events are excluded. Sync your selections to update these dates. No calendar provider is contacted by this check.
calendarOverlaps.failed: Could not load calendar overlap warnings.
calendarOverlaps.disconnected: Connect your calendar to check active imports.
calendarOverlaps.noSources: Select a calendar to check its imported events.
calendarOverlaps.pendingSource: {source}: waiting for the first successful sync; not included yet.
calendarOverlaps.count: {count, plural, one {# overlapping pair} other {# overlapping pairs}}
calendarOverlaps.empty: No overlaps found in the saved timed events.
